name: Bishoujo Tengoku
source:
Today is the exam day of a first class Tokyo academy where Masahiro  transferred just recently. The exam is finally over and it's time to seek adventures in the academy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天是正弘不久前刚刚转入的东京名门学园举行考试的日子。考试终于结束，现在该到校园里寻找冒险了。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
